title: Zema Dataset: A Comprehensive Study of Yaredawi Zema with a Focus on Horologium Chants
reasoning: The paper describes the creation of a dataset for the analysis of Yaredawi Zema, which are the liturgical chants of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church (EOTC). It provides extensive background on the spiritual schools, the sacred nature of the music, and the symbolic religious meanings of the chanting modes (e.g., their connection to the Holy Trinity).
